sections.heading: Type power
lines: Apple Acid, Bubble, Bubble Beam, Energy Ball, Misty Explosion, and Sparkling Aria also count as Poison for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Acid Spray, Apple Acid, Bubble, Bubble Beam, Clear Smog, Smog, and Sparkling Aria: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Poison-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Gravity changes the field into Corrosive. The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.

Bleakwind Storm, Burning Jealousy, Defog, Eruption, Explosion, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Gust, Heat Wave, Hurricane, Incinerate, Inferno Overdrive, Lava Plume, Mind Blown, Razor Wind, Searing Shot, Self-Destruct, Supersonic Skystrike, Tailwind, Twister, and Whirlwind break the field apart, exposing whatever lay beneath it.
Seed Flare changes the field into Misty Terrain.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Water Compaction: Defense +2 when it enters.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Dry Skin restores 1/8 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Attack +1, Special Attack +1, and suffers bad poison.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
